name: ServiceNow Enterprise ITSM Integration
description: Integration pack for ServiceNow, providing connectivity to ServiceNow Table APIs for Incident Management (INC), Change Request (CHG) CAB approvals, Problem Management (PRB), and CMDB Configuration Items (CI).

capabilities.name: Production Support & Incident Management
capabilities.description: Integrates ServiceNow Incident intake (P1-P4), automated ticket assignment, and SLA tracking.

capabilities.name: Change Management
capabilities.description: Integrates ServiceNow Change Requests (Standard, Normal, Emergency), CAB approval workflows, and change risk scoring.

capabilities.name: Configuration Management
capabilities.description: Integrates ServiceNow CMDB Configuration Items (CIs), dependency relationship mapping, and asset attributes.

checklists.name: ServiceNow Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ServiceNow OAuth 2.0 / Basic Auth API access, Incident creation, and Change Request state sync.

items.statement: ServiceNow Service Account authenticates with rest_service role for Table API endpoint access.
Incident creation auto-populates Mandatory fields (Caller, Short Description, Impact, Urgency, Assignment Group).
Change Requests transition through State gates (Draft -> Assess -> Authorize -> Scheduled -> Implement) per CAB rules.

reviewGates.name: ServiceNow Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The ITSM Administrator confirms that ServiceNow REST API connections and Change Request workflows operate properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the ServiceNow integration verify Incident creation and Change Request CAB workflow synchronization?
